bills.title: Communications Legislation Amendment (Prominence and Anti-siphoning) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-07-04.81.1) to keep item 24 of schedule 1 unchanged, which means it will remain as it is. This vote was put in response to a [Jacqui Lambie Network amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-07-04.81.1) to oppose the item. ### What is item 24 of schedule 1? According to the [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2324a/24bd057): > *Item 24 of Part 2 of Schedule 1 of the Bill provides that the obligations imposed in relation to regulated television devices under the prominence framework apply to a device that is manufactured on or after the day that is 18 months after the commencement of the Schedule, or is supplied on or after that date.*
